boxes.title: NHRC & SHRC: added rules
items: NHRC removal: by **President** after ==**SC inquiry**== (misbehaviour/incapacity); reappointment allowed
**2019**: Centre may give **UT** functions to SHRCs; **Delhi** stays with NHRC
SHRC panel: **CM**, Speaker, Home Minister, LoP (+ Council Chairman & LoP)
SHRC won't take a case already before NHRC or another commission
SC asked if SHRC chairs could act as **State Information Commissions** (**11 Feb 2026**)
NHRC notices to AP DGP, CS on **Gade Sai Krishna** custodial death, **Art. 21** (**28 Jun 2026**)

boxes.title: NCW, NCM, NCPCR, NCSK: added detail
items: NCW: **3 years**, removal by Centre; ==Centre must consult NCW== on major policy
NCM: **5** incl. chair from minorities; **15** State Minorities Commissions (incl. AP)
NCPCR: SC menstrual-hygiene ruling (**Feb 2026**); RTE **25%** seats, **Sec 12(1)(c)**
NCSK: under **MoSJE**; set up **1993** (⚠ other notes: 1994); Vice-Chair **Hardeep Singh Gill**
NCSK missed-call grievance line, **23 Aug 2026**; **NAMASTE** (**2022**, NSKFDC)
